articles.summary: Where the story has been, and where the notes run out.

facts.text: The campaign is a customised run of Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen with homebrew adventures.
The group had earlier adventures before the main Dragonlance storyline.
Vogler features in the campaign's early setting.
A later Halloween adventure took place aboard the Bone Pelican.
Documents disagree over the spelling of the port the party is working from.

sections.heading: The story so far
sections.body:
This is a Dragonlance campaign that follows Shadow of the Dragon Queen where it suits us and wanders off where it doesn't.

The group was already adventuring together before the main story began. Those early days centre on [[vogler|Vogler]], and the notes from them name [[swift-claw|Swift Claw]], [[frost|Frost]], [[orkus|Orkus]] and [[pubert|Pubert]].

Later came a Halloween voyage aboard the [[the-bone-pelican|Bone Pelican]], where a ghost asked the party to find out who had killed her. That is the [[the-bone-pelican-murder|murder aboard the Bone Pelican]], and it is how [[gears|Gears]] came to travel with the party.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.body:
It was Halloween, and the party was at sea aboard the [[the-bone-pelican|Bone Pelican]].

A spirit named [[jenna|Jenna]] came to them with a plain accusation: she had been murdered. So the party set about finding out by whom.

The evidence came in pieces. A medical scalpel had gone missing. A latch had been damaged. There were cord fibres to account for. The party searched the suspects' cabins. Somewhere in the middle of it [[gears|Gears]], a mechanical adventurer, threw in with them.

It ended when [[charlie-jennings|Charlie]] tried to flee and was caught.

sections.heading: Afterwards
sections.body:
- Jenna's spirit is now bound up with a [[jennas-silver-pendant|silver pendant]].
- Each member of the party was paid 10 gold pieces.
- Gears stayed.
- Before the session closed there was the first hint of a heist.

sections.heading: Loose ends (DM)
sections.body:
The recap this was written from is transcript-derived and has not been checked against the full recording. It never states what Charlie actually did, only that Charlie ran. Settle that before a players' version of this page goes up.

The heist hint points at [[operation-dragon-nest|Operation Dragon Nest]]. The planning notes disagree on how much the party was told.

sections.heading: The job
sections.body:
**Not played.** These are planning notes. Nothing here has happened, and any of it may change.

A covert operation built around Dragon Army intelligence. The target is the [[dragon-nest-site|Dragon Nest site]]. Scouts sent that way have not come back, and finding out why is part of the job.

What the party is really walking into is on the [[dragon-nest-dm-dossier|DM dossier]].

sections.heading: Before it runs
sections.body:

- Merge the runbook and the print packet into this page. They were not available when this draft was written.

**Not played.** These are planning notes. Nothing here has happened, and any of it may change.

Behind the ordinary business of the [[dragon-nest-site|site]] there is an experimental program, and at the centre of it are [[metallic-dragon-eggs|four metallic dragon eggs]].

This is the reveal the whole operation is built around. Nothing player-facing should mention eggs, experiments or bonding until the party finds them.
